messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] interpretation of traceplot
parts:
The usual explanation is that you're getting into portions of the posterior
with different curvature that are hard to get out of once you get into
them. This isn't a bug --- it's just a consequence of the fact that HMC
and NUTS satisfy detailed balance.

The reason it's hard to step out is usually that adaptation has
created too large a step size. So what you can try to do is lower
the step size. The easiest way to do this is to up the target
acceptance rate (delta).

- Bob
